prompt: Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Use Spectrum 1-10: page #1C1D16, text #F5F7F3, accent #8AE59A, secondary surface #252C37, text on accent #111111. Set headings in Bagnard and reading text in Aileron; characterful display serif with quiet supporting text. Composition: Narrow index beside an unframed detail pane; index becomes a menu on mobile. Use body 16px, heading 64px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 32px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
